data.gender_notes: Pavla is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'pavlos', meaning 'stone' or 'rock'. In Christian tradition, Pavla is the female form of the name Paul, which means 'small' or 'humble' in Latin. This name carries the symbolism of strength, resilience, and steadfastness. The name Pavla carries the meaning “Rock, Stone” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Pavla usually hope their child will grow to embody rock, stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Paula
